WITH candidate AS (
    SELECT j.id
    FROM hubspot_sync_jobs j
    WHERE (
        j.status = 'pending'
        OR (
            j.status = 'failed'
            AND j.next_retry_at <= NOW()
        )
        OR (
            j.status = 'processing'
            AND j.lease_expires_at <= NOW()
        )
    )
    AND j.attempt_count < 3
    ORDER BY j.id
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 1
),
claimed AS (
    UPDATE hubspot_sync_jobs j
    SET
        status = 'processing',
        attempt_count = j.attempt_count + 1,
        claim_token = gen_random_uuid(),
        lease_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '10 minutes',
        next_retry_at = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM candidate
    WHERE j.id = candidate.id
    RETURNING j.*
)
SELECT
    j.id AS job_id,
    j.customer_id,
    j.claim_token,
    j.attempt_count,
    c.full_name,
    c.primary_email,
    c.phone,
    c.company,
    c.hubspot_contact_id
FROM claimed j
JOIN customers c ON c.id = j.customer_id;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        j.id AS job_id,
        j.customer_id
    FROM hubspot_sync_jobs j
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.id = j.customer_id
    WHERE j.id = $1::bigint
      AND j.claim_token = $2::uuid
      AND j.customer_id = $3::bigint
      AND j.status = 'processing'
      AND j.lease_expires_at > NOW()
      AND (
          c.hubspot_contact_id IS NULL
          OR c.hubspot_contact_id = $4::text
      )
    FOR UPDATE OF j, c
),
updated_customer AS (
    UPDATE customers c
    SET
        hubspot_contact_id = $4::text,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM eligible e
    WHERE c.id = e.customer_id
    RETURNING c.id
),
updated_job AS (
    UPDATE hubspot_sync_jobs j
    SET
        status = 'completed',
        hubspot_contact_id = $4::text,
        claim_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL,
        completed_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM updated_customer c
    WHERE j.id = $1::bigint
      AND j.customer_id = c.id
    RETURNING j.id, j.customer_id
),
logged AS (
    INSERT INTO sync_audit_logs (
        customer_id,
        action,
        outcome,
        details
    )
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        'hubspot_contact_sync',
        'completed',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'hubspot_contact_id', $4::text,
            'sync_action', $5::text
        )
    FROM updated_job
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated_job) AS completed_jobs,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logged) AS audit_records,
    $4::text AS hubspot_contact_id;
